bouquet.summary: Avenue Supermarts combines robust top‑line growth, industry‑leading profitability, a clean balance sheet and a technically attractive entry point after a short‑term pullback, offering a compelling 12‑20% upside with limited downside risk.
bouquet.whyToday: The stock just completed a clean bullish flag breakout on strong volume, aligning a solid fundamentals backdrop with a low‑risk technical setup, making today the optimal entry point for the next 3‑6 months.

positives: Revenue CAGR ~20% FY22-25 driven by same‑store sales and new store rollout
ROCE >25% and ROE ~22% – among the highest in Indian consumer sector
Operating margin expansion from 9% to 11% over last 3 years
Strong cash conversion cycle and high free cash flow yield
negatives: Exposure to rural consumption slowdown if inflation spikes

positives: Q4 FY26 earnings beat expectations; net profit up 18% YoY
Institutional investors (e.g., Motilal Oswal, SBI Funds) added ~5% stake in last month
Government’s push for organized retail and GST compliance benefits DMart’s model
Announcement of new hyper‑local fulfillment centers to accelerate e‑commerce integration
negatives: Short‑term concern over higher input costs (packaging, logistics) due to global commodity price rise

positives: Price formed a bullish flag on the daily chart after a 6% pullback from recent high
RSI at 42, indicating room for upside without being overbought
MACD line crossed above signal line two sessions ago with rising histogram
Volume spike on the breakout day confirming buying interest
negatives: Near 52‑week high resistance at ~4,800 INR; a break above is needed for full upside

positives: Minimal debt and no pledged shares from promoters
Historical beta ~0.7 – lower volatility than broader Nifty
Business model is highly scalable with low capital intensity
negatives: Concentration risk: >70% of revenue from Tier‑2/3 cities, which can be sensitive to regional economic shocks
